name: Launch Text Keyword Opt-In — Text EARLY, Double Confirmation, Consent Tags

source.spec: launch-automations.spec.md §3.2 — Opt-in confirmation + keyword opt-in (e.g. "Text EARLY")
source.capability_note: automation-templates/launch-ghl-probe/GHL-CAPABILITY-NOTE.md — Customer Replied / inbound-message triggers are not auto-built by CampaignBuilder; use `caf workflows patch-trigger` or the Tier-4 managed browser
source.consent_rules: Every text ends with a reply invitation and STOP. Send window 08:00–21:00 recipient local. Nothing sends unless A2P 10DLC is approved.
source.voice: Skill 50 copy voice — first person, short, plain, one idea per message, no hype, no fake urgency.

purpose: Turn an inbound text of the launch keyword (default EARLY) into a recorded, double-confirmed SMS subscriber. The keyword only starts the handshake: the contact must reply YES before any launch text is ever sent. STOP always wins. Outside the send window the confirmation waits for the next 08:00 local.

keyword.normalization: trim surrounding whitespace, uppercase, exact single token match
keyword.note: One keyword per launch. The value comes from the launch plan / launch intake, never from free text typed by a model.

trigger.primary_event: Inbound SMS whose normalized body equals {{opt_in_keyword}}
trigger.trigger_build: CampaignBuilder creates Tag Added triggers only. Write this Customer Replied trigger with `caf workflows patch-trigger --trigger-json <file>` on the internal API (snapshot before write), or through the Tier-4 managed browser where the engine has no verified payload.
entry_conditions: The inbound message is SMS from a contact with a valid phone number
The contact does not already have sms-opted-out
exit_conditions: Contact replies YES and is tagged text-optin-confirmed + sms-subscribed
Contact does not confirm within 24 hours and is dropped (no further sends)
Contact texts STOP and is suppressed across every launch text set
trigger.duplicate_handling: If the contact already has text-optin-confirmed, do not re-send the handshake and do not re-tag. At most one confirmation message per 24 hours per contact.
trigger.unmatched_keyword: No message, no tag. Do not auto-reply to any other body. A human or Conversation AI may answer separately and must not add SMS consent.

channels: SMS outbound (double opt-in prompt + confirmed acknowledgement)

compliance.a2p_not_ready_behavior: The workflow stays a draft and nothing sends. The launch package records a warning: texts cannot send until A2P 10DLC is approved.
compliance.opt_out_handling: STOP is honored by the carrier / GHL opt-out layer and by the workflow: add sms-opted-out, remove sms-subscribed, text-optin-pending, text-optin-confirmed and every launch text tag. No further launch text may send. No promotional reply to STOP.
compliance.reply_invitation: Every outbound message in this set ends with an invitation to reply.
compliance.outside_window_behavior: Hold the outbound confirmation and send it at the next 08:00 recipient local. Inbound messages are captured immediately; only the outbound send waits.
compliance.no_purchase_needed: Keyword opt-in is consent capture. It is not a purchase and must not imply one.
compliance.promotional_note: This set is consent and schedule information only. It carries no price, offer, bonus or checkout link, so it does not count against the 3–5 promotional text cap.

sequence.what_it_does: Match normalized body to {{opt_in_keyword}} (exact, case-insensitive). Non-match exits with no send.
sequence.build: Customer Replied trigger, channel SMS, exact phrase, case-insensitive

sequence.what_it_does: If sms-opted-out or text-optin-confirmed is present → exit (no send). Else continue.
Add text-optin-pending. Set text_optin_keyword = {{opt_in_keyword}} and text_optin_started_at = now.

sequence.timing: until 08:00 recipient local when the keyword arrives outside 08:00–21:00; otherwise no wait
sequence.what_it_does: Holds the outbound confirmation inside the send window.
sequence.build: Event/clock wait is not a verified API payload — managed browser (references/workflow-timing.md)

sequence.timing: inside the send window, immediately after step 4
sequence.what_it_does: Sends the double opt-in prompt. This is message 1 of 2. Text ends with a reply invitation and STOP.
sequence.message: Got it — this is {{founder_first_name}} with {{brand_name}}. Reply YES and I'll text you when the doors open and when they're about to close. Questions? Just reply here. Reply STOP to opt out.

sequence.what_it_does: Add text-optin-confirmed and sms-subscribed. Remove text-optin-pending. Set text_optin_confirmed_at = now.

sequence.timing: on the confirmed branch, inside the send window
sequence.what_it_does: Sends the confirmed acknowledgement and the real launch timing. This is message 2 of 2. Text ends with a reply invitation and STOP.
sequence.message: You're in. Doors open {{doors_open_at}} and close {{doors_close_at}}. I'll text you at both, and nothing in between unless you reply. Reply STOP to opt out.

sequence.timing: on the unconfirmed branch after the 24-hour wait
sequence.what_it_does: Remove text-optin-pending. Send nothing. The contact can text {{opt_in_keyword}} again later.
Closes the keyword opt-in set. Launch reminders, doors-open, last-call and access-link texts are separate sets in launch-text/.

yes_reply_branch.trigger: Customer Replied, SMS, exact YES, filtered to contacts holding text-optin-pending
yes_reply_branch.scope: Only this workflow and only while text-optin-pending is present, so a YES to any other conversation cannot grant SMS consent.
yes_reply_branch.build: Second Customer Replied trigger in the same workflow, or a small companion workflow — patch-trigger either way

nodes: Trigger: Customer Replied (SMS, exact phrase {{opt_in_keyword}}, case-insensitive)
If/Else: sms-opted-out or text-optin-confirmed present → exit
Action: Add Tag text-optin-pending; Set text_optin_keyword, text_optin_started_at
Wait Until: next 08:00 recipient local (only when outside 08:00–21:00)
SMS 1: double opt-in prompt (reply invitation + STOP)
If/Else: text-optin-confirmed present? Yes → add text-optin-confirmed + sms-subscribed, remove text-optin-pending, set text_optin_confirmed_at, send SMS 2; No → remove text-optin-pending, no send
notes: Everything stays a draft. Nothing goes live, nothing sends, no client account is touched during the build.
When A2P is not approved the workflow is still built as a draft and the package warns that texts cannot send.
The second trigger (YES while text-optin-pending) is scoped to this workflow so it cannot capture consent from another conversation.

qc.t1: Two text points exist, both with a reply invitation and STOP, send window 08:00–21:00, promotional false.
qc.t2: a2p_ready = false → workflow stays draft and the package warns.
